blocks.text: Bu mavzu o'zbek tiliga juda yaqin. O'zbekchada **har** / **har bir** dan keyin ot birlikda: **har bir** talaba, **har** kuni. Inglizchada **every** ham xuddi shunday — **birlikdagi** ot bilan: **every** student, **every** day. O'zbekcha **hamma** / **barcha** dan keyin ot ko'pincha ko'plikda: **hamma** talabalar. Inglizchada **all** ham — **ko'plikdagi** ot bilan: **all** students. Ma'nosi bir xil: **Every** room has a TV = **All** the rooms have a TV.

rows: **Every** student **has** a book. — Har bir talabada kitob bor.
**All** students **have** books. — Hamma talabalarda kitob bor.
**All** the milk **is** in the fridge. — Butun sut muzlatgichda.

blocks.text: **every** guruhdagi har bir a'zoni alohida-alohida ko'radi, shuning uchun undan keyin ot ham, fe'l ham **birlikda**: **every** house **is** ..., **every** child **needs** ... «every students» yoki «every days» deyilmaydi. Vaqt bilan **every** «qanchalik tez-tez» degan savolga javob beradi: **every** week, **every** two hours (har ikki soatda).

items.text: **Every** house in this street is painted white.
items.translation: Bu ko'chadagi **har bir** uy oqqa bo'yalgan.

items.text: The doctor sees **every** patient twice a day.
items.translation: Shifokor **har bir** bemorni kuniga ikki marta ko'radi.

items.text: I check my phone **every** five minutes — it's a bad habit.
items.translation: Telefonimni **har** besh daqiqada tekshiraman — bu yomon odat.

blocks.text: **all** guruhga bir butun sifatida qaraydi: **all** + ko'plikdagi ot (fe'l ko'plikda) yoki **all** + sanalmaydigan ot (fe'l birlikda). Umumiy gapda — **the** siz: **All** children need love (dunyodagi hamma bolalar). Aniq guruh haqida — **all the** yoki **all** + egalik olmoshi: **all the** children in my class, **all** my friends. **all of** ... → 81-dars.

items.text: **All** the windows were open, so the room was cold.
items.translation: **Hamma** derazalar ochiq edi, shuning uchun xona sovuq edi.

items.text: Bekzod spent **all** his money on a new phone.

blocks.text: **every-** + **body / one / thing / where**: **everybody** = **everyone** (hamma, har kim), **everything** (hamma narsa), **everywhere** (hamma joyda / joyga). Ma'nosi ko'plik bo'lsa ham, fe'l **birlikda**: Everybody **is** happy, Everything **was** great. O'zbekchada ham «Hamma **keldi**» deymiz, lekin o'zbeklar inglizchada ko'pincha «Everybody are» deb xato qiladi.

Diqqat: «hamma narsa» ma'nosida yolg'iz **all** emas, **everything** ishlatiladi: «All is ready» emas — **Everything** is ready; «I understood all» emas — I understood **everything**. **all** esa odatda ot bilan keladi: **all** the food.

items.text: **Everyone** was talking about the new teacher.
We packed **everything** the night before the trip.
In autumn there are yellow leaves **everywhere**.

blocks.text: Vaqt bilan farq muhim: **every** day — **har** kuni (qanchalik tez-tez?), **all** day — kun **bo'yi**, butun kun (qancha vaqt?). O'zbekchada ham ikki xil: «har kuni» va «kun bo'yi». **all** dan keyin bu yerda **the** ishlatilmaydi: **all day**, **all night**, **all week**.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «every students» → **every student**; «all student» → **all students** / **all the students**; «Everybody are here.» → **Everybody is here.**; «Every student have a book.» → **Every student has a book.**; «All is OK.» → **Everything is OK.**; «I study English all days.» → **every day** (har kuni) — all day esa «kun bo'yi».
Eslab qolish: **every** = **har** (birlik), **all** = **hamma** (ko'plik). **every-** bilan boshlanadigan so'zlar (everybody, everything) doim birlik fe'l oladi: **is**, **has**, **was**.
Bog'liq darslar: **most, some, any, none** va **all of** ... → 81-dars; ikki narsa haqida **both / either / neither** → 82-dars; **nobody / nothing** (everybody ning teskarisi) → 78-dars.

rows: I work **every day**. It rained **all day**.

examples.title: **every** + singular noun
examples.description: **every** dan keyin ot **birlikda**, fe'l ham birlikda: **every** room **has** ... O'zbekchadagi «har» / «har bir» bilan bir xil.

sentences.text: **Every** room in this hotel has a balcony.
sentences.translation: Bu mehmonxonaning **har bir** xonasida balkon bor.

sentences.text: Aziz goes to the gym **every** morning before work.
sentences.translation: Aziz **har kuni** ertalab ishdan oldin sport zaliga boradi.

sentences.text: Our teacher knows the name of **every** student in the school.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz maktabdagi **har bir** o'quvchining ismini biladi.

sentences.text: **Every** child in the class got a small present.
sentences.translation: Sinfdagi **har bir** bolaga kichik sovg'a berildi.

sentences.text: Madina calls her mother **every** evening.
sentences.translation: Madina onasiga **har oqshom** qo'ng'iroq qiladi.

sentences.text: I've read **every** book by this writer.
sentences.translation: Bu yozuvchining **har bir** kitobini o'qiganman.

sentences.text: There's a bus to the airport **every** twenty minutes.
sentences.translation: Aeroportga **har** yigirma daqiqada avtobus bor.

sentences.text: Not **every** shop in the centre is open on Sundays.
sentences.translation: Markazdagi **hamma** do'konlar ham yakshanba kuni ochiq bo'lavermaydi.

sentences.text: Bekzod has been to **every** country in Central Asia.
sentences.translation: Bekzod Markaziy Osiyoning **har bir** davlatida bo'lgan.

sentences.text: **Every** time I visit Bukhara, I discover something new.
sentences.translation: Buxoroga **har** borganimda, yangi bir narsani kashf qilaman.

examples.title: **all** + plural or uncountable noun
examples.description: **all** + ko'plikdagi ot (all children — hamma bolalar), fe'l ko'plikda. Sanalmaydigan ot bilan ham: **all** the water. Aniq guruh haqida — **all the** ... yoki **all my** ...

sentences.text: **All** children love stories before bed.
sentences.translation: **Hamma** bolalar uxlashdan oldin ertak eshitishni yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: **All** the shops in our street close at nine.
sentences.translation: Ko'chamizdagi **hamma** do'konlar soat to'qqizda yopiladi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza spent **all** her money on books.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **butun** pulini kitobga sarfladi.

sentences.text: I've invited **all** my friends to the party.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatga **hamma** do'stlarimni taklif qildim.

sentences.text: **All** the students in our group passed the test.
sentences.translation: Guruhimizdagi **barcha** talabalar testdan o'tdi.

sentences.text: Tom ate **all** the cake before we came home!
sentences.translation: Biz uyga kelgunimizcha Tom tortni **butunlay** yeb qo'yibdi!

sentences.text: Are **all** these bags yours?
sentences.translation: Bu sumkalarning **hammasi** siznikimi?

sentences.text: Not **all** the flights are cancelled — ours is on time.
sentences.translation: Reyslarning **hammasi** ham bekor qilinmagan — biznikisi o'z vaqtida.

sentences.text: My grandmother keeps **all** her old letters in a box.
sentences.translation: Buvim **hamma** eski xatlarini qutida saqlaydi.

sentences.text: We drank **all** the water during the walk, so we bought some more in the village.
sentences.translation: Sayr paytida **bor** suvni ichib qo'ydik, shuning uchun qishloqdan yana sotib oldik.

examples.title: **everybody** / **everyone** + singular verb
examples.description: **everybody** = **everyone** («hamma», «har kim»). Ma'nosi ko'plik bo'lsa ham, fe'l **birlikda**: Everybody **is** here. «Everybody are» — xato.

sentences.text: **Everybody** is ready — let's go!
sentences.translation: **Hamma** tayyor — ketdik!

sentences.text: **Everyone** in my family loves plov.
sentences.translation: Oilamda **hamma** palovni yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: Good morning, **everyone**! Please sit down and open your books.
sentences.translation: **Hammaga** xayrli tong! Iltimos, o'tiring va kitoblaringizni oching.

sentences.text: Not **everybody** likes spicy food.
sentences.translation: Achchiq ovqatni **hamma** ham yoqtiravermaydi.

sentences.text: Bekzod is very friendly — he says hello to **everyone** in the street.
sentences.translation: Bekzod juda samimiy — ko'chada **hamma** bilan salomlashadi.

sentences.text: **Everybody** has a mobile phone these days.
sentences.translation: Hozir **hammaning** mobil telefoni bor.

sentences.text: Was **everyone** happy with the hotel?
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonadan **hamma** mamnun bo'ldimi?

sentences.text: Sarah knows **everybody** in her village.
sentences.translation: Sara qishlog'idagi **hammani** taniydi.

sentences.text: When the film ended, **everyone** stood up and clapped.
sentences.translation: Film tugaganida **hamma** o'rnidan turib qarsak chaldi.

sentences.text: Does **everybody** understand the homework?
sentences.translation: Uy vazifasini **hamma** tushundimi?

examples.title: **everything** and **everywhere**
examples.description: **everything** — «hamma narsa», **everywhere** — «hamma joyda / joyga». Fe'l birlikda: Everything **is** ready. «All is ready» o'rniga — **Everything** is ready.

sentences.text: **Everything** is ready for the party.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatga **hamma narsa** tayyor.

sentences.text: I looked **everywhere** for my keys, but I couldn't find them.
sentences.translation: Kalitlarimni **hamma joydan** qidirdim, lekin topa olmadim.

sentences.text: Thank you for **everything** — you've been very kind.
sentences.translation: **Hamma narsa** uchun rahmat — juda mehribonlik qildingiz.

sentences.text: There are tourists **everywhere** in Samarkand in spring.
sentences.translation: Bahorda Samarqandda **hamma joyda** sayyohlar.

sentences.text: **Everything** in this shop costs one pound.
sentences.translation: Bu do'kondagi **hamma narsa** bir funt turadi.

sentences.text: Madina tells her sister **everything**.
sentences.translation: Madina opasiga **hamma narsani** aytib beradi.

sentences.text: Our dog follows us **everywhere**.
sentences.translation: Itimiz biz bilan **hamma joyga** ergashib boradi.

sentences.text: Is **everything** OK? You look worried.
sentences.translation: **Hammasi** joyidami? Xavotirda ko'rinyapsiz.

sentences.text: After the storm, there was water **everywhere** in the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Bo'rondan keyin oshxonaning **hamma joyi** suv bo'lib ketdi.

sentences.text: James lost **everything** in the fire, but his family was safe.
sentences.translation: Jeyms yong'inda **hamma narsasidan** ayrildi, lekin oilasi omon qoldi.

examples.title: **every day** or **all day**?
examples.description: **every day** — har kuni (qanchalik tez-tez), **all day** — kun bo'yi (qancha vaqt). Xuddi shunday: every morning / all morning, every week / all week.

sentences.text: I drink green tea **every day**.
sentences.translation: Men **har kuni** ko'k choy ichaman.

sentences.text: Yesterday it rained **all day**, so we stayed inside.
sentences.translation: Kecha **kun bo'yi** yomg'ir yog'di, shuning uchun uyda qoldik.

sentences.text: Tom works in the garden **every** Saturday.
sentences.translation: Tom **har** shanba bog'da ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Last Saturday he worked in the garden **all** morning.
sentences.translation: O'tgan shanba u **ertalab bo'yi** bog'da ishladi.

sentences.text: The baby cried **all night**, and nobody slept.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq **tun bo'yi** yig'ladi, hech kim uxlamadi.

sentences.text: Madina visits her grandparents **every** summer.
sentences.translation: Madina **har** yozda buvisi va bobosinikiga boradi.

sentences.text: We were at the beach **all week**, and it was sunny **every day**.
sentences.translation: **Hafta bo'yi** plyajda bo'ldik, **har kuni** quyoshli edi.

sentences.text: Bekzod was so ill that he stayed in bed **all** weekend.
sentences.translation: Bekzod shunchalik kasal bo'ldiki, **dam olish kunlari bo'yi** yotdi.

sentences.text: The museum is open **every day** except Monday.
sentences.translation: Muzey dushanbadan tashqari **har kuni** ochiq.

sentences.text: My neighbour plays loud music **all the time** — it's terrible!
sentences.translation: Qo'shnim **doim** baland ovozda musiqa qo'yadi — dahshat!

examples.title: **every** + singular = **all** + plural
examples.description: Bir fikrni ikki xil aytish mumkin: **Every** room **has** a TV = **All** the rooms **have** a TV. every bilan ot va fe'l birlikda, all bilan — ko'plikda.

sentences.text: **Every** flat in our building has two bedrooms.
sentences.translation: Binomizdagi **har bir** kvartirada ikkita yotoqxona bor.

sentences.text: **All** the flats in the new building have big windows.
sentences.translation: Yangi binodagi **hamma** kvartiralarning derazalari katta.

sentences.text: **Every** player in the team is from Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Jamoadagi **har bir** o'yinchi Toshkentdan.

sentences.text: After the match, **all** the players were tired.
sentences.translation: O'yindan keyin **hamma** o'yinchilar charchagan edi.

sentences.text: In our school, **every** pupil wears a uniform.
sentences.translation: Maktabimizda **har bir** o'quvchi forma kiyadi.

sentences.text: In some countries, **all** pupils study two foreign languages.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi mamlakatlarda **barcha** o'quvchilar ikkita chet tilini o'rganadi.

sentences.text: The teacher read **every** essay twice.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi **har bir** inshoni ikki marta o'qib chiqdi.

sentences.text: Emma has visited **all** the museums in London.
sentences.translation: Emma Londondagi **barcha** muzeylarda bo'lgan.

sentences.text: **Every** guest at the wedding got a box of sweets.
sentences.translation: To'ydagi **har bir** mehmonga bir quti shirinlik berildi.

sentences.text: **All** the guests were dancing when the music stopped.
sentences.translation: Musiqa to'xtaganda **hamma** mehmonlar raqs tushayotgan edi.

examples.title: Getting ready for a party: Is **everything** ready?
examples.description: Ziyofatga tayyorgarlik suhbati: **everything**, **everybody**, **everywhere**, **every** + birlik, **all** + ko'plik va **all morning / all day**.

sentences.text: — Is **everything** ready for tonight's party?
sentences.translation: — Bugungi ziyofatga **hamma narsa** tayyormi?

sentences.text: — Almost. I've cleaned **every** room, and the food is in the kitchen.
sentences.translation: — Deyarli. **Har bir** xonani tozaladim, ovqat oshxonada.

sentences.text: — Great. Has **everybody** got the address?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Manzil **hammada** bormi?

sentences.text: — Yes, I sent it to **all** our friends yesterday.
sentences.translation: — Ha, kecha **hamma** do'stlarimizga yubordim.

sentences.text: — Are **all** the chairs in the living room?
sentences.translation: — **Hamma** stullar mehmonxonadami?

sentences.text: — Not yet. I was busy with the cooking **all** morning.
sentences.translation: — Hali yo'q. **Ertalab bo'yi** ovqat pishirish bilan band bo'ldim.

sentences.text: — Don't worry, I'll do it. Did you buy drinks for **everyone**?
sentences.translation: — Xavotir olma, men qilaman. **Hamma** uchun ichimlik oldingmi?

sentences.text: — Yes, there's juice **everywhere** — in the fridge, on the balcony...
sentences.translation: — Ha, sharbat **hamma joyda** — muzlatgichda, balkonda...

sentences.text: — Perfect. I think **everybody** is going to have a great time.
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib. Menimcha, **hamma** zo'r vaqt o'tkazadi.

sentences.text: — I hope so! After all this work, I want to sleep **all day** tomorrow.
sentences.translation: — Shunday bo'lsin! Shuncha ishdan keyin ertaga **kun bo'yi** uxlagim keladi.

examples.title: Mixed practice: **every**, **all**, **everybody**, **everything**
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: **every** + birlik, **all** + ko'plik, every- so'zlari + birlik fe'l, **every** va **all** vaqt bilan.

sentences.text: **Every** Friday our family has dinner at my grandparents' house.
sentences.translation: **Har** juma oilamiz bobom va buvimnikida kechki ovqat qiladi.

sentences.text: **Everybody** was surprised when Aziz won the competition.
sentences.translation: Aziz musobaqada g'olib chiqqanida **hamma** hayron qoldi.

sentences.text: I spent **all** afternoon looking for a present for Madina.
sentences.translation: **Peshindan kechgacha** Madinaga sovg'a qidirdim.

sentences.text: Not **all** the questions in the test were difficult.
sentences.translation: Testdagi **hamma** savollar ham qiyin emas edi.

sentences.text: Sarah takes her camera **everywhere**.
sentences.translation: Sara fotoapparatini **hamma joyga** olib yuradi.

sentences.text: Did you understand **everything** in the lecture?
sentences.translation: Ma'ruzadagi **hamma narsani** tushundingizmi?

sentences.text: The trains to Manchester leave **every** hour.
sentences.translation: Manchesterga poyezdlar **har** soatda jo'naydi.

sentences.text: **All** my cousins live in Fergana, but I live in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: **Hamma** amakivachchalarim Farg'onada yashaydi, men esa Toshkentda.

sentences.text: It was so hot that **everyone** went to the river.
sentences.translation: Shunchalik issiq ediki, **hamma** daryoga ketdi.

sentences.text: James checks his emails **every** ten minutes — it drives **everybody** crazy.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **har** o'n daqiqada pochtasini tekshiradi — bu **hammaning** jig'iga tegadi.
